name: sports-bot-hybrid-source-gate-followup
summary: Fixes remaining CandidateFactory source gates so Tier B single-line-source candidates reach controlled fallback; final EV/value guards remain strict.
notes: Previous patch enabled CORE_LINE_BOOKMAKER_UNIVERSE_ALLOW_SINGLE_SOURCE, but model.CandidateFactory still used settings.min_sources_publish and market-derived min source gates while building candidates.
This patch relaxes only candidate discovery while the wrapper runs; settings are restored immediately after build_candidates returns.
Final publication is still controlled by fallback canonical EV/edge, xG sanity, quality stops, 2+ books, context confirmations and tier thresholds.
SStats remains context-only; Bzzoiro/SportLogic remain line sources only when real odds/offers exist.
